question: The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Amendment) Bill, 2021 was introduced in Lok Sabha on December 6, 2021 which seeks to punish financing illicit activities or harbouring persons engaged in them with rigorous imprisonment of at least ten years (extendable up to 20 years) and a fine of at least ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ₹1,00,000**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Amendment) Bill, 2021 was introduced in Lok Sabha on December 6, 2021 which seeks to punish financing illicit activities or harbouring persons engaged in them with rigorous imprisonment of at least ten years (extendable up to 20 years) and a fine of at least ₹1,00,000

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** **The Parliament passed the Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) (Amendment) Bill, 2021 with the **Rajya Sabha approving it on 20 December 2021.**
 
• It seeks to replace the **Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (Amendment) Ordinance, 2021.**
 
• The Bill amends the **Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985** to correct a drafting error.
 
• The N**DPS Act regulate**s certain operations (such as manufacture, transport, and consumption) related to narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.

4a:T
